meta.principles: DRY/YAGNI/KISS, work within existing, prefer built-in/standard, global fixes (single-source, not repeated), no clashing/duplicate impls, refactor where it helps, prefer LSP, UI work MUST use frontend-design skill (plugin)
meta.subagent_briefing_required: Every implementation subagent gets: (1) this principles line, (2) docs to read: root CLAUDE.md + v2/CLAUDE.md + .planning/codebase/CONVENTIONS.md + CONCERNS.md + convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md + the relevant .planning/pr-review-since-19001ba/<area>.md report, (3) for UI: MUST invoke frontend-design skill, (4) the specific issue id/file:line/fix, (5) make global single-source fixes, no duplication, verify with LSP/tests, no unrelated changes
meta.verification_sequence: typecheck -> lint -> FULL test suite (test:run) -> build  (fix until all clean, no skips)
meta.deploy_sequence: commit all -> push -> npx convex deploy -y -> verify Vercel (MCP + CLI) — each step only after prior fully succeeds

decisions_needed.q: Email normalization (I1): forward-only normalize-on-write, OR also backfill-migrate existing mixed-case users (dedupe + fix suspension bypass)?
decisions_needed.recommend: Explore first (count mixed-case users + check if @convex-dev/auth already lowercases); default: normalize-on-write + lowercase the lookup, and a guarded one-time migration only if real mixed-case rows exist

decisions_needed.q: BotID /api/auth/* no-op (I8): remove the dead protect entry (auth already guarded by Turnstile+rate-limit), OR wire server-side checkBotId() on the auth path (extra layer)?
decisions_needed.recommend: Wire checkBotId on /api/auth (adds real protection) — but verify @convex-dev/auth proxy path supports it; fallback: remove dead entry + fix comment

decisions_needed.q: Mid-stream AI provider failure (I6): telemetry-only (distinct captureError; mid-stream failover is acknowledged-acceptable + complex), OR implement mid-stream failover?
decisions_needed.recommend: Telemetry-only (YAGNI; true mid-stream failover risks double-billing/duplicate streams)

decisions_needed.q: Client IP extraction (S13/S15): adopt Vercel's trusted IP header (x-vercel-forwarded-for / rightmost trusted hop) and stop trusting leftmost x-forwarded-for + the shared 'unknown' bucket?
decisions_needed.recommend: Yes — research correct Vercel IP extraction; use trusted hop; make 'unknown' fail-open per-request, not a shared real bucket

issues.issue: IDOR: getMarketingSubscriptionStatus/updateMarketingSubscription trust client-supplied email; only check getUserIdentity -> any authed user can read/unsubscribe any contact
issues.fix: Resolve caller's own email server-side (getCurrentUserId + internal user lookup); reject mismatch

issues.issue: Errored/aborted/partial assistant turns persisted as clean messages; server streams error as literal assistant text -> transcript corruption feeding compaction
issues.fix: Guard persistence on isError/isAbort/isDisconnect; stop returning user-facing error as stream text content (use proper error channel)

issues.issue: Email send failure swallowed (console only); user advanced to code-entry with no code sent; Resend outage invisible
issues.fix: recordError on send failure + surface to caller so UI can show real error (don't advance silently)

issues.issue: Returns 200 even when DB write throws -> Resend won't retry -> audit events lost; occurredAt NaN if created_at unparseable (v.number passes NaN? rejects -> throw -> 200)
issues.fix: Number.isFinite guard on occurredAt; return 5xx on internal write failure (svix dedup makes retry safe), 400 only on malformed payload

issues.issue: rateLimit.test asserts stale caps (LOGIN 10 vs 20 etc) -> RED (verified); conversationSummary.test fails/needs rate-limiter wired into convex-test harness; no Vitest CI catches red tests
